headline: Move A.J. Brown to IR now (nothing is locked yet) and start Quinshon Judkins in his place before Sunday's 10 AM PT kickoffs; grab free-agent WR Devaughn Vele for the bench spot the IR move opens.
summary: Danny is 0-0 in week 2 with nothing locked yet. A.J. Brown is out at least six weeks with a high ankle sprain, so free the WR spot for IR now and hand it to Judkins, Cleveland's clear early-down back with Sampson out. The open bench spot is worth spending on Devaughn Vele, who ran 92% of Saints routes and drew 9 targets in week 1.

lineup.why: A.J. Brown's move to IR (see ir) opens a starting spot; Judkins is Cleveland's clear early- and passing-down back this week with the highest projected touches on your bench.
lineup.evidence: Dylan Sampson (knee) was ruled out for the rest of week 1 and Cleveland is down to Judkins and Raheim Sanders as its only active backs (Sept 8 reports); Judkins' 2025 ankle fracture is fully resolved and he was cleared with no lingering issue for the 2026 opener (Sept 2026 reports), 16 projected carries plus 2.3 targets is a clear lead role even though CLE is an 8.5-point underdog at TB.

adds.why: Free agent right now; the bench spot A.J. Brown's IR move opens is worth spending on the league's most-added WR off a huge week 1 role.
adds.evidence: Vele ran a route on 92% of Tyler Shough's dropbacks and drew 9 targets (8 catches, 69 yards, a TD) in week 1, New Orleans' No. 2 behind Olave while first-round rookie Jordyn Tyson is still on IR (reports dated Sept 13-14); that beats the target volume of your bench WRs Tre Tucker (5.4) and Khalil Shakir (5.8).

ir.why: Placed on New England's IR Sept 11 with a high ankle sprain, expected out 6+ weeks (Sept 11-13 reports); nothing is locked yet this week so the move can go through now instead of waiting.

flags.what: High ankle sprain, on IR, out 6+ weeks (Sept 11-13 news) — move to Danny's IR
Confirmed the clear No. 2 behind Bucky Irving, pass-catching/third-down role (reports this week)
Green Bay is running a backfield committee with Lloyd, Chris Brooks and Kaleb Johnson while Jacobs remains on the exempt list (Sept reports) — not a clear workhorse

watch.what: Shares Joe Burrow's bye in week 6, leaving only Caleb Williams startable that week; no starting-caliber free-agent QB is available yet — watch the wire and claim one with a different bye around the week 4 run
Watch Green Bay's carry split each week; he only clears bench-stash value if Brooks and Kaleb Johnson fade or Jacobs' exempt-list case drags on
Thursday vs Detroit is a plus matchup (Buffalo favored, 29-point implied total) but his 5.8 targets are still thin volume for a start

alerts.title: 🔴 Move A.J. Brown to IR
alerts.body: Ankle sprain has him on NE's IR for 6+ weeks and nothing is locked this week — move him to IR now to open the bench spot.

alerts.title: 🔁 Start Judkins for Brown
alerts.body: Once Brown is on IR, start Judkins — Cleveland's clear lead back with Sampson (knee) out — before Sunday's 10 AM PT kickoffs.

alerts.title: ➕ Add WR Devaughn Vele, no bid
alerts.body: Free agent right now for the bench spot Brown's IR move opens: 92% route rate and 9 targets in week 1 for New Orleans.
